distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) described Amasa youlii from Fujian (Fuzhou, Qishan). Lin et al. (2024) adds a new provincial record from Yunnan based on one female collected in the Jinuo Mountains, Xishuangbanna. Mainland China remains treated as present.

host_note: The source states that the host is unknown and that the specimen was potentially collected from Fagaceae. This is retained as a questionable association and is not promoted to Current Host Summary.
taxonomy_summary: Amasa youlii Smith, Beaver & Cognato, 2020 is the current accepted identity.

taxonomic_history.name: Amasa youlii
taxonomic_history.note: Described as a new species; original-description p. 47.
